author: aobolensk
title: Android CXX_Unit_Tests fails - emulator adb daemon unreachable, device stays offline during boot
signature: unable to connect to adb daemon on port adb device offline during emulator boot|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: CXX_Unit_Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Android emulator failed to bring the device online (adb device offline), blocking CPU unit test execution

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_android
failed_jobs.symptom: Downstream aggregate status job fails because CXX_Unit_Tests failed

key_errors: ERROR        | Unable to connect to adb daemon on port: 5037

adb: device offline
The process '/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb' failed with exit code 1
WARNING      | adb command '... shell am broadcast -a com.android.emulator.multidisplay.START ...' failed: 'Broadcasting: Intent {...} cmd: Failure calling service activity: Broken pipe (32)'
root_cause: The Android x86_64 emulator (reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner) failed to establish an adb connection immediately after boot ('Unable to connect to adb daemon on port: 5037'), leaving the device reporting 'offline' for ~20 seconds of polling before adb finally connected (boot completed in 38406 ms, much slower than usual). This is a known transient flakiness of the headless, software-rendered (swiftshader) x86_64 emulator under containerized CI runners: the adb daemon inside the emulator's guest OS sometimes isn't ready by the time the host-side wait-for-device polling starts, and the emulator's own waiting/broadcast step after boot additionally hit a 'Broken pipe' on the multidisplay service broadcast, causing the post-boot action itself to exit with code 224 (treated as a step failure) even though the unit tests could in principle have still run. No code change in the PR (which only touches src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/shared_tests_instances/skip_tests_config.cpp, an x86_64/CPU test-skip list) interacts with the Android emulator subsystem, so the failure is unrelated to the PR's diff.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally; intermittent emulator/adb startup race under CI container load. To attempt reproduction: run the 'CXX_Unit_Tests' Android job's android-emulator-runner step repeatedly in a resource-constrained container (e.g., limited CPU cores) with api-level 30, google_apis, x86_64, -gpu swiftshader_indirect, and observe adb daemon connection timing after emulator launch.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CXX_Unit_Tests job; this is the standard remedy for a one-off emulator adb daemon connectivity glitch.

Consider increasing the android-emulator-runner 'emulator-boot-timeout' or adding a short retry/backoff around the initial 'adb wait-for-device' / post-boot broadcast step so a slow guest adb daemon does not fail the whole job.

If this recurs frequently, consider pinning the emulator package version or disabling hardware/display broadcast steps (e.g., disable-animations tuning) that trigger the Broken pipe warning after boot.
prevention_strategies: Track recurrence of adb daemon connectivity failures in the Android emulator CI jobs; if this signature appears 3+ times within 12 hours, treat it as infrastructure instability in the emulator/runner image and escalate to the CI platform owners rather than re-triaging PRs repeatedly.
historical_context: Related but distinct emulator/adb infrastructure issues have been seen before: 'Android Build x64 fails uploading unit test artifact due to Azure blob storage DNS resolution failure' (pattern 8a9dfcece16ecc76, Network, 2 occurrences) and 'Android CXX_Unit_Tests fails at Download CPU unit test binary step' (pattern b9bb8c1499335214, Infrastructure, 1 occurrence). This specific 'adb daemon unreachable / device offline during boot' signature has not been recorded before in the pattern database (new signature bbf7249294bc184f).
